subject.title: Add option to hide session status card

question: Should status visibility use a whole-card toggle, a section-level privacy policy, or remain always visible?
rationale: Adding a core configuration key requires intent on chat behavior, tool-result structure, and disclosure of usage or billing data across trust boundaries.

options.title: Section-level visibility
options.body: Define a shared allowlist or suppression policy for sensitive status sections across chat and tool output.

options.title: Whole-card toggle
options.body: Add a boolean that suppresses rendered status output while preserving the current default.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Reject the new configuration surface and retain the always-rendered card.

recommendation.title: Section-level visibility
recommendation.body: Define a shared allowlist or suppression policy for sensitive status sections across chat and tool output.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the refactor that established the shared status owner boundary.
